Al-Hashimi, Mohan, and King assess a woman with sudden blindness.11User reviews5Critic reviewsPhotos3Featured reviewsThe Pitt is amazing!I love this series! It's been awful waiting a week for each episode, but every Friday I realize the wait was worth it. Practically all the characters captivate me in different ways, and in this episode I developed a strong empathy for a patient who didn't even have 20 minutes of screen time (the one with abdominal pain). Besides secondary arcs (the relationship between Langdon and Santos) unfolding, the real climax of the season was finally established. Can't wait - but I will - for the next episode.PaperworkThere is no such thing as a 'photographic memory.' Dr Abbott (Shawn Hatosy) was back and that is always good.Katherine LaNasa (Dana) has become the star of this series.Shabana Azeez (Dr Javadi) is a lousy actress who constantly uses that look of totally surprise.It would be impossible to dislike Santos any deeper!The consistency continuesI don't think that they're hitting that sophomore slump at all. I know last season it was around 2pm when things really started to hit the fan so I'm very excited to see how it all goes heading into the afternoon.They keep this tone, pace and storytelling up each season I think it might be a favorite of mine. Love being here for this moment in TV right now.This show is my new obsessionI don't have a ton to say about the episode, it's great. From the party girl, to the big guy, it was all great! But the part the stands out for me was at the very end, when Robbie and Dana are standing looking at the analogue chaos and suddenly the definition of the screen goes from HD to 480. Just a neat little part that felt cool to notice.Wracking & Stacking (Send Him to the Zoo)Felt like this was a great episode. Several arcs/patients got wrapped up from previous episodes and a few good nuggets started and ended here too.Good comedic moments, heartfelt moments, plenty of subtle interactions here and there.Particularly enjoyed the story of Mr Knox and his nasotracheal intubation. One of my favourite stories from the season so far.Also enjoy reading some of the rage-bait on reviewers on here who really need to go visit an actual hospital, might change their perspective on the show. Who knows, maybe they just like dunking on realistic stuff week after week.Related interestsContribute to this pageSuggest an edit or add missing contentEdit pageMore to explore
